title: Multi-Turn Consistency Lie Detector for Deployed Chat

original_idea.body: # Multi-Turn Consistency Lie Detector. Seed a private false claim, re-query the fact later in varied ways, score cross-turn consistency to flag sustained deception; report per-model sustained-lie rates.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Cross-turn consistency lie detection for deployment monitoring; clear chain to catching sustained deception.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Scripted multi-turn dialogues + consistency scoring; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused consistency-tool prototype; lie-vs-confusion disambiguation adds effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Deployment-monitoring tool on open/API models; labs underweight.

low_compute.reasoning: Chat inference loops, API or small local model.

novelty.reasoning: Consistency-based deception detection cited; a compact multi-turn tool plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Consistency analysis known; compact multi-turn tool plausibly open.
